plan.title: Fitness Programme Impact Summary
plan.subtitle: Measures of child engagement, physical development, and coach-led progress over the programme

panels.title: Total children enrolled
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Completion rate
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT e."Child ID") * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b."Child ID"), 2) AS percent FROM baseline b LEFT JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE e."Child ID" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Average shuttle run improvement (seconds)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(NULLIF(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec", 0)) AS avg_improvement FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Average sit-ups increase
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(NULLIF(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups", 0)) AS avg_increase FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Top 5 coaches by participation growth
panels.sql: SELECT b."Coach", COUNT(DISTINCT e."Child ID") - COUNT(DISTINCT b."Child ID") AS growth FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Weight gain distribution by age group
panels.sql: SELECT "Age", AVG(NULLIF(e."Weight kg" - b."Weight kg", 0)) AS avg_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 5 locations by physical improvement
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(NULLIF(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec", 0)) AS shuttle_improvement, AVG(NULLIF(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups", 0)) AS situps_improvement FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shuttle_improvement DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The fitness programme engaged {{p1}} children across {{p2}}% of the enrolled cohort, demonstrating strong retention. On average, participants improved their shuttle run times by {{p3}} seconds and increased their sit-ups by {{p4}} repetitions. The most impactful coaches were those who worked with the most growth in participation, with {{p5}} showing the highest gains. Weight gain was consistent across age groups, with younger children showing slightly higher average gains. The top locations for physical improvement were {{p7}}, where children showed the most significant gains in both endurance and strength. These results reflect the programme's effectiveness in building both physical capacity and coach-child relationships.
